source.note: Reference contains a landscape cinematic clip embedded in a portrait short-video UI. Style extraction targets the clip itself, not the surrounding app UI.

adult_character.proportions: heroic/slender adult, realistic shoulder and torso volume
adult_character.face: narrower adult face, smaller eyes than child, sharper nose/jaw
adult_character.hair: layered dark hair with strand breakup and rim-light response
adult_character.costume: dark historical/fantasy layered cloth + leather/metal accents

child_character.proportions: large head, short body, soft limbs
child_character.face: very large eyes, round cheeks, small nose/mouth, soft skin shading
child_character.hair: dark twin-bun / tied style with readable silhouette

visual_identity.contrast_rule: Do not force adult and child into the same facial proportion system. Their controlled style contrast is part of the reference appeal.

lighting.rim: strong warm edge light on hair and shoulders
lighting.contrast: medium-high cinematic contrast with protected faces

camera.depth_of_field: shallow to medium; faces sharp, background characters/camp softened
camera.height: around adult chest/child eye relationship depending on shot
camera.movement: slow push-in, small reframing, no game-like orbit

composition.interaction: clear eye-line relationship and height difference
composition.background: camp / historical environment with human silhouettes and props
composition.foreground: occasional body/prop edge or atmospheric particle for depth

shading.skin: soft subsurface-like response without plastic gloss
shading.cloth: rough diffuse cloth with selective edge highlights
shading.outline: subtle; avoid thick cartoon contour around everything
shading.target: cinematic 3D animation, not flat toon cutout and not photoreal game render

color.grade: warm highlights + neutral/cooler shadows, restrained saturation

motion.adult: restrained head/eye reactions, small arm/hand gestures
motion.child: more expressive head tilt, mouth/eye reaction, hand gesture
motion.secondary: hair ornaments, tied hair, sleeves move after primary body motion

demo_beats.beat: adult and child two-shot, child looks up, adult notices
child raises one hand and speaks; adult eye-line follows
adult small reaction/answer, slight camera push-in
child close reaction; sleeve/hair settle with delayed secondary motion

non_negotiable_quality_gate: adult and child read as volumetric 3D characters
child face has large-eye soft chibi appeal without looking like a flat sticker
adult face remains more mature and semi-realistic
sunset rim light and background depth are visible
background is softened by DOF rather than painted as a flat card
hair and sleeves have delayed secondary motion
camera movement feels cinematic, not like viewport navigation
final result must be judged from rendered motion, not a rig editor view
